messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPUs saturated in us-west-2 cluster 'us-west-2-gpu-n1'. Queue length 12,130, avg wait ~45s. Autoscaler attempted scale but received ProviderQuotaExceeded from cloud provider. Affected routes: /v1/generate (hosted). Severity: P1. Pager: @alyssa (oncall), @raj (eng-sre). Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/gpu-capacity-exhaustion

alyssa (oncall): ack — I'm on it. Paging SRE + runtime. Starting triage now.

raj (eng-sre): looking at autoscaler logs, seeing repeated 403/QuotaExceeded from provider: "InsufficientAcceleratorQuota". Autoscaler retried, then hit backoff. Logs: ```2026-03-15T03:12:10Z autoscaler controller: scale attempt -> 50 nodes, provider error InsufficientAcceleratorQuota; retrying backoff 30s```

cheng (eng-runtime): adding context: queue is primarily token-heavy gen with long sequences (avg seq 1024). Batching increased but still queuing. We have fallback model variants (smaller quantized) but routing hasn't been triggered because policy pins hosted route to 'redwood-m40-large'.

tim (infra): I can provision ephemeral instances in eu-west-1 if we want cross-region failover, but need approval to shift traffic. Also can request increased quota from provider but that takes hours.

maria (customer-success): we have live customers experiencing timeouts on chat features. CS is already replying to top 3 paying customers with temporary guidance: use chat-summary endpoint. Need an ETA for mitigation to pass along.

alyssa (oncall): mitigation plan options: 1) manual scale down model (switch route to 'redwood-m40-medium') 2) redirect a percentage of hosted traffic to eu region (requires config change and CORS check) 3) trigger manual node provisioning via spare capacity in dedicated pools. Which is fastest?

raj (eng-sre): fastest is model downgrade/routing to smaller model. I can push a canary split 30% -> medium in 5m. That will reduce tokens/sec and free queue.

cheng (eng-runtime): agree. I'll prepare the alternate model variant and validate compatibility. Also will enable prefix KV cache for the heavy routes to reduce recompute.

alyssa (oncall): please do the canary. raj, can you run the split? Post the rollout command here.

raj (eng-sre): running rollout now: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/rollouts -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","split":{"redwood-m40-large":70,"redwood-m40-medium":30}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROCK'```

ops-bot: rollout deployed: route /v1/generate split updated -> large:70%, medium:30%. Observing metrics.

alyssa (oncall): queue length dropping?

ops-bot: queue length: 12,130 -> 7,480 over 6m. Avg latency 45s -> 28s. Request rate unchanged.

maria (customer-success): telling customers ETA ~20-30m for primary mitigation. Thank you.

tim (infra): I'm still provisioning EU nodes as standby. If splitting doesn't fully recover we can shift extra traffic. Estimated time to bring up: 12-18m for instance boot + model load.

raj (eng-sre): autoscaler controller restarted (rolling restart) to clear stuck backoff tokens: ```kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/autoscaler-controller``` Logs show subsequent scale attempts still get InsufficientAcceleratorQuota but retries now not blocked by controller state.

cheng (eng-runtime): cache + model downgrade combined reduced per-token GPU time ~40%. Queue now steady at ~4k and decreasing.

alyssa (oncall): good. Action items for immediate: - raj: confirm queue <1k or continue canary increase - cheng: monitor model output quality for medium variant (evals on sample prompts) - tim: continue EU standby provisioning - maria: keep customers updated with 15m cadence

raj (eng-sre): will progressively shift to 50/50 if queue keeps dropping. Next update in 10m.

(10m later)

ops-bot: metrics update: queue 4,120 -> 980. Avg latency 28s -> 12s. Error rate ~0.2% (was 1.8%).

alyssa (oncall): queue <1k. Marking incident as mitigated for customer impact; still P1 but moving to recovery. Starting postmortem tracking.

maria (customer-success): notifying top customers incident mitigated; one wants a write-up and timeline.

raj (eng-sre): immediate follow-ups: open ticket to request quota increase with provider (owner: tim), update autoscaler backoff logic to reduce impact when provider returns 429/Quota, and add a preemptive fallback in routing to auto-downgrade model when queue exceeds threshold (owner: cheng).

cheng (eng-runtime): will add canary and auto-fallback rules to the routing policy: if queue > 2000 for 3m -> shift 30% -> medium, if still >2000 -> 60%. Also add quality regression checks tied to eval set to alert before large shifts.

tim (infra): I filed provider ticket: case #PROV-81234, flagged urgent. Also opened internal ticket to allow cross-region temporary provisioning for hosted routes.

alyssa (oncall): postmortem owners: raj (incident lead), cheng (runtime follow-ups), tim (quota/provisioning), maria (customer comms). I will draft timeline and notes. Meeting to review RCA tomorrow 10:00 PT.

ops-bot: reaction :white_check_mark: recorded. Closing slack pager thread.

(leave this thread as the single source of record for chronological messages; postmortem doc to be created in docs and linked from here)
